text:
Nadia: Heads up — Prospect Aster Labs needs hosted POC access next week. Requirements: per-integration hosted API keys, IP allowlist 192.0.2.55/32, daily rotation, and a hard kill at end of 7-day trial. They also want audit export to their S3.

Carlos: I can create per-integration ephemeral keys. Suggest 48h TTL with overlap rotation (create new, wait 2h, revoke old). Sample: `redwoodctl keys create --type=ephemeral --scopes=generation,embeddings --allowed-ips=192.0.2.55/32 --ttl=48h --note="Aster-<integration>"`.

Eve: Compliance: confirm issuance, rotation, and revoke events are logged with actor and key_id. For S3 export we need their bucket ARN and a cross-account role with PutObject. No CMK unless they request.

Carlos: Plan: create keys, push tokens to their vault or our secure delivery link, wire rotation job that updates tokens and revokes old after 2h. I'll own automation.

Nadia: Also include simple revoke instructions for their infra team and a one-click console revoke. We should schedule an automatic revoke job for day 7 00:00 UTC.

Carlos: Will do. I'll draft handoff doc with curl examples and revoke steps. Example usage: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" -d '{"input":"summarize notes"}' https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate`.

audit-bot: Audit export job created -> destination pending ARN. Reminder scheduled 24h before expiry (1746114710).

Eve: If they ask for longer POC, we'll issue new keys with updated TTLs and rerun the audit export permission step. No long-lived tokens for demos.

Nadia: Thanks — I'll collect their bucket ARN and list of integrations. Ping here if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
